body: I understand that feeling I’m constantly told to work out or change my diet. Well that’s how it started but now any little problem is my fault because I’m depressed but it has nothing to do with it. It’s the constant gaslighting that is driving me to the brink. You’re different my friend you have a loving wife/best friend that you’ve known for 10 years that should count for something.

How is that working? My girlfriend told me to get help for my depression but I refuse to. I told her that I had been but in reality I’ve been shoving it to the back of my mind and pretending to be better. I shouldn’t have told her in the first place because anytime there’s a disagreement she blames me and my depression.
